topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I walked out to the driveway this morning, the sun just starting to spill over the horizon, painting the world in a warm, golden hue. My car, or rather, the space where my car should have been, greeted me with an unsettling emptiness. A chalk outline marked the spot, a cruel parody of the vehicle that used to sit there. It wasn’t just gone; it had vanished as if spirited away by the night itself. The note on the ground, a small, crumpled piece of paper, explained it all—towed away. But the driveway is mine. The sense of violation was staggering, like someone had not just taken my car but had also defaced a part of my personal space. I stood there, the morning light growing warmer, a plan already forming in my mind. This wasn’t just a setback; it was a challenge, and I was ready to meet it head-on.
